preservationNote: Preservation fields describe the goal of each edit, not a measured claim of perfect preservation.
mediaPolicy: Official model recordings stream from their authors' project pages. Local volume, reverberation, and equalization recordings are FFmpeg derivatives of selected demo inputs, with provenance in assets/audio/media-volume-generation.json and assets/audio/media-acoustic-generation.json. Reverberation examples display a processed input and the unmodified original as output. The source recordings retain their original terms. Denoising pairs use local MUSAN-noise mixtures as inputs and the unmodified originals as outputs; provenance is recorded in assets/audio/denoising-generation.json.
